reason: The shared FilterResults schema uses oneOf for arrays of hashes and arrays of logs. Both branches match an empty array, rejecting a valid empty eth_getLogs result. Use anyOf for this method only to admit their overlap while preserving the existing public two-branch generated model and all non-empty branch constraints. This does not extend the method admission/protected logs contract to hash results.
retireWhen: Review on every pin change. Remove when the upstream eth_getLogs result admits an empty log array without ambiguous oneOf validation. A future method-specific logs-only model requires a separate public type and method-semantics migration.
